patch.title: platform/x86: oxpec: Add OneXPlayer 3 quirk
patch.author: Antheas Kapenekakis
patch.scope: Exact ONEXPLAYER 3 DMI quirk only; no EC policy changes

hardware_validation: Installed matching signed module and persistent provider; preserved firmware 80%, verified 75% then restored 80%, and verified the live SteamOS Manager -1-to-100% mapping before restoring 80%. Steam client reports charge support with a 50–100% range. Physical charging, resume and reboot remain separate checks.
